name: Shenzhen Noposion Crop Science Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Noposion Crop Science Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells agricultural inputs China and internationally. The company offers pesticide formulations and fresh produce consumer products; insecticides, fungicides, and herbicides; and fresh consumer goods that include blueberries, dragon fruit, and bird's nest fruit. It also provides wheat, rice, and chili solutions. The company operates its own brands, such as Noposion, Ruidefeng, and Biaozheng. The company was formerly known as Shenzhen Noposion Agrochemicals Co.,Ltd and changed its name to Shenzhen Noposion Crop Science Co., Ltd. in June 2023.
